title: LinkedDevice
description: What one device says about itself to the others. Each device writes only its own entry, under furlough.device.<id>, and deletes it on leaving — so the roster is the set of entries and no blob is ever fought over.

id.description: The device id, equal to the <id> in the key and to the anchor record's writer.

name.description: What the person called it. Trimmed; an empty name becomes the platform's own word (iPhone, iPad, Mac). iOS stopped telling third-party apps the device's name in iOS 16, so on a phone this is typed in the guide.

platform.description: What it is. The same enum the anchor record carries.

enrolledAt.description: When it joined. A revocation older than this is spent: the device was taken off and came back. Carried over unchanged when the entry is refreshed.

lastSeen.description: When it last wrote anything. Refreshed by every enrollment and every addition, so a device gone quiet for a month reads as one.

canRelease.description: Whether a tag can be read on it, which is the only thing that releases an anchor. True for an iPhone; never for an iPad or a Mac, neither of which has a reader.
